chunks: So bear patiently what they say, and sing the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun and its setting,

key_terms.بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ: With the praise of your Lord

ai.seo_question: What are the specific times for glorifying God mentioned in Surah Qaf?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Qaf, this verse addresses the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) during the Meccan period, instructing him to maintain steadfastness against the disbelievers' mockery by combining patience with the specific ritual of morning and evening Tasbih. Shia exegetes, such as Al-Tabarsi and Al-Kulayni, highlight this as a model for spiritual resilience, where constant dhikr serves as both a shield against external criticism and a means of internal purification, establishing a rhythm of worship that anchors the believer's heart in divine remembrance amidst worldly trials.
